requirementSections.rawText:
Additional Courses: Require a grade of C or better
Select 9 credits of introductory-level courses (200-level) from the following:9
ENGL 212Introduction to Fiction Writing
ENGL 213Introduction to Poetry Writing
ENGL 214Introduction to Creative Nonfiction Writing
ENGL 215Introduction to General Nonfiction Writing
ENGL 260Theory & Practice of Screenwriting
ENGL 281Television Script Writing

ENGL 410Advanced TV Script Writing
ENGL 411MHonors Seminar in English: Creative Writing
ENGL 412Advanced Fiction Writing
ENGL 413Advanced Poetry Writing
ENGL 414Biographical Writing

ENGL 435The American Short Story
